thread:
Priya: FYI QA flagged a high tail latency related to model-pinning + cold-starts on the MVP branch. p99 spikes when tenant requests hit pinned-heavy models during scale events. Need a decision: cut model pinning from MVP, or accept a launch-timeline slip to implement warming & heuristics.
Diego: can you summarize repro? is this steady-state or traffic-burst related?
Priya: it's bursty. repro on tenant-surge test: pinned models cause eviction/reload waves, GPUs recompile kernels, and p99 jumps ~1.2s for some routes. No correctness break, just latency SLO risk.
Nina: root cause looks like our current pinning strategy pins full model shards to tenant queues without warm pool. When we scale down, we drop warmed state and have to reload.
Omar: short options: 1) remove model-pinning for MVP and route all tenants to shared pool (fastest), 2) keep pinning but add a tiny warm pool + optimistic prefetch (medium), 3) ship pinning but restrict to enterprise tenants only in MVP (partial ship).
Kai: effort estimates: 1) ~3 eng-days (config + QA), 2) ~12 eng-days (warm pool + eviction heuristics + tests), 3) ~6 eng-days (tiered routing + billing flags).
Helena: customer view: enterprise pilots expect isolation/pinning but would tolerate a deferred guarantee if we communicate. A few pilots flagged pinning as critical but not blocking initial usage.
Priya: timeline constraints: feature-freeze in 5 business days. If we pick 2 we slip the milestone ~2 weeks. 1 or 3 keep current ship window.
Diego: tradeoffs: removing pinning reduces isolation guarantees and could increase cost for noisy neighbors on tail latency, but preserves launch. We can label pinning as a v1 guaranteed SLA.
Nina: if we choose 1, add a risk note in the launch checklist and a follow-up ticket to reintroduce pinning with warm pool + metrics for p99 + cold-starts.
Omar: quick config snippet if we flip off pinning for MVP:
```yaml
runtime:
  model_pinning:
    enabled: false
    mode: shared_pool
```
Omar: I'll add a feature flag 'mvp.model_pinning_disabled' and a smoke test to validate no regressions.
Kai: monitoring: when we re-enable, we need two lightweight metrics: cold_load_latency_ms and pinned_model_evictions. Add alerts if cold_load_latency_ms > 500ms for >5min.
Helena: comms: I'll prep a customer-facing note that explains exact behavior and timeline for v1 pinning, and include mitigation tips for heavy workloads.
Priya: proposed decision: go with option 1 (disable model pinning for MVP), mark model-pinning as deferred to v1 with warm-pool plan. Approve? @Diego @Kai @Nina
Diego: +1, prefers predictable SLOs.
Nina: +1, will draft the follow-up spec for warm pool (includes eviction heuristics and prefetch).
Kai: +1, will add metrics + alert rules to the monitoring backlog and own the slide for the launch readout.
Omar: +1, will open PR EOD and add the smoke job in staging.
Helena: +1 from CS. I'll notify pilot customers and add a FAQ entry.
deploy-bot: CI checks queued for config change.
Priya: actions: Omar  PR + staging smoke (due: 2026-04-02), Nina  write v1 warm-pool spec (due: 2026-04-09), Kai  metrics + alert backlog item (due: 2026-04-06), Helena  customer comms + FAQ (due: 2026-04-02). I'll update the milestone tracker and mark "model-pinning" as v1 deferred.
Diego: one follow-up, please add a short note in the milestone doc about potential cost delta for shared_pool so finance isn't surprised.
Priya: will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
